title: Mall World Repeat Dreams
content: I have similar dreams of a mall that has a food court, hotel, casino, water park and seems dated with late 70s or early 80s decor. Sometimes there is an education centre connected to it. It is typically dimly lit and grey and I am typically an employee looking for someone. I use to have beautiful lucid dreams but these are different, darker, confusing. Since having these dreams my lucid dreaming ability has diminished significantly. They are not positive dreams but the feeling of being lost and needing to get somewhere. I had an interaction with a man in the food court of whom I did not recognize but felt it was a dark presence and needed to leave. I feel like there is an aspect of our current technology and society that is impacting our subconscious and our collective conscious. Has anyone been able to have progression been able to reshape, change or have any ideas on what we are experiencing?
